title: ✨ Cleaner Look + Watchlist, Scouting, Report Cards
notes: 🎨 A cleaner look. Sections are open now, with one box per trade, deal or matchup. No more boxes inside boxes.
📋 The Briefing got faces: player photos and team logos on every line, grouped into This Week, Your Move, Your Roster, On the Market and Headlines. It also shows who you have out.
⭐ New: Watchlist. Open any player and tap Watch. Research > Watch tracks their value, trend and news, and Find a Deal takes you straight to the Trade Finder for them.
🕵️ New: Scouting reports. In Research > League, open a team (or tap its bubble on the map) to see what they need, how they trade, their best players and deals to pitch.
📈 New: Trade report cards. Every trade in the Feed shows how each side's value has moved since the deal.
🤖 Ask is now an "Ask Claude about this" button at the bottom of Outlook, Plan, Market and League, with questions that fit each screen.
🏛️ The Vault is tidier: Records, Draft, Team Value, Managers, Players and Rivalry, with nothing stacked above or below the tabs.
📐 Compact is back in Settings. If you used it before, you are already on it again.
